narration_timeline.text: Why does a grey heron seem almost motionless beside a busy river?
narration_timeline.scene: Heron visible at the edge of a river.

narration_timeline.text: Its long legs let it stand in shallow water without wetting most of its body.
One bird waits among reeds, while another takes careful steps along a grassy bank.
narration_timeline.scene: Heron among reeds followed by heron moving on a grassy bank.

narration_timeline.text: Against bright reflections, that slim shape can nearly disappear into the wetland.
narration_timeline.scene: Heron dark silhouette in strongly backlit water.

narration_timeline.text: Even on an island shore, a heron can watch the water from the edge.
narration_timeline.scene: Grey heron at coastal shore; verify original Aran Islands video.

narration_timeline.text: Back beside the river, its long neck and pointed bill make this patient bird easy to recognize.
narration_timeline.scene: Two distinct heron videos by the river; not the same individual.
